Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Regional Haruna Iddrisu announces €325m loan plan to address water shortages in three Northern cities Source : Anass Sabit 21 November 2026 11:54pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Education Minister and Tamale South MP, Haruna Iddrisu, says a €325 million loan agreement to support water infrastructure projects in Tamale, Damongo and Yendi will be laid before Parliament next week.
He made the announcement at a ceremony in Tamale organised by members of Ahlussunna wal Jama'a (ASWAJ) to celebrate the selection of Sheikh Ibrahim Basha Iddris, popularly known as Sheikh Bayaan, as the group's interim National Imam.
Addressing the gathering, Mr Iddrisu said Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson would present the agreement to Parliament.
“Next week, the Finance Minister, Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, will lay before Parliament a loan agreement of 325 million euros to end the water crisis in Tamale, Damongo, and Yendi,” he said.
The proposed financing is expected to support major water infrastructure development in the three municipalities, where residents have experienced persistent challenges with reliable water supply.
If approved by Parliament, the loan would provide funding for the planned interventions, although details of the project components, implementation timeline and expected completion dates were not provided in the announcement.
The proposed investment is intended to improve access to potable water for households, businesses and public institutions in the beneficiary communities.
The Education Minister also described Sheikh Bayaan's selection as interim National Imam of ASWAJ as a significant moment for the organisation and the wider Muslim community.
He expressed hope that the new leader's tenure would contribute to the advancement of Islamic education in Ghana.
“The choice of Sheikh Bayaan to lead ASWAJ as National Imam is a proud moment, and I am hopeful that his reign will be remembered for his enormous contribution to Islamic education in the country,” he said.
The ceremony brought together members of ASWAJ in Tamale, who gathered to celebrate Sheikh Bayaan and pledge their allegiance to his leadership.
